'''Cantis Bralor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] member of the [[Hidden Chain]]. Around [[3624 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> he led the [[Raid on Port Nowhere|raid]] on [[Port Nowhere]] with the goal of capturing hostages. The [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Rass Ordo]] were present aboard the station and helped repel the attack, [[Death/Legends|killing]] Cantis Bralor.<ref name="TOR" />
